real_model.note: One controlled local example per stage. Initial visit test player name contained banned word 模型 and was rejected; ordinary in-world name passed. No speed or long-run quality benchmark.

visual_review.computer_use_review: Opened new build with isolated save; actual UI scrolling confirmed 人生信条 / 说话 / 他怎么看你 labels and contents display without overlaps.

preserved_local_work: All 171 non-overlapping tracked local modifications/deletions retained at merge. README and two server files backed up and reconciled; build includes local character and combat changes present at build start.
source_snapshot_note: Build-input hashes remained unchanged through build completion and the post-build integrity check. A separate ongoing task later edited the listed combat sources; those later edits remain untouched and are outside this validated artifact.
attempt_notes: Initial pytest collected tooling under output; discarded in favor of documented unittest discover -s tests.
First isolated fixture omitted initial goals for two added actors; corrected fixture passed.
Hidden-window captures unavailable; visible-window native rerun captured real UI and passed.
limitations: No rerun of upstream multi-year simulation comparisons.
No new claim about combat balance, long replay stability, or all-character art quality.
Already running game sessions continue using their loaded build until restarted.
